set.body:
Need (storyatlas4s Recall Voyage, 2026-09-03): the voyage encodes how an anchor came to be as
shape, never colour (ADR 0002 V-U5): circle for the posterior argmax, diamond for a decode-bound
anchor, hollow dashed diamond for a decode-filled one. `PointShape` offers Circle, Square,
Triangle, Cross (GraphicsTypes.scala:100-104), so every diamond became a `Polygon` built by hand,
losing `Points`/`PointBatch` (one grob per mark instead of one batch), the `size` semantics, and
the shared point-size law.

Proposal: `PointShape.Diamond`; optionally `Star`/`Plus` and an explicit "open" (fill = none)
convention documented for every shape. Area parity: a diamond of size s covers the same area as
the circle of size s, so a size-by-value encoding reads the same across shapes.

Acceptance:
- Diamond renders in SVG, Canvas, Java2D, JavaFX; conformance suite covers it;
- a law pins the area-parity rule and the hit-test bounds;
- storyatlas4s `VoyageLowering.markLayer` can move to a single `PointBatch` with per-point shapes.
set.title: [Intaglio 1.x][Scene] PointShape.Diamond (and open variants), so an epistemic state can be a shape in a point batch
